note: The deliberate disagreement row. The where is 99 literal nodes, which both accounting models charge at one unit each, so the two charges land within a few units of each other (~150,002 Go, ~150,004 Python) -- above the Go runtime's 100,000-unit default budget and below the Python implementation's 200,000-unit default. Compatibility: 'Two evaluators that both define limits may define different ones, so no facts document is guaranteed to be above the limit for both, and a portable exceeds-the-mandated-limit error row cannot be written from a MUST-define alone.' This row is that sentence, executed. Expectation is 'unpinned': the RFC fixes no common limit, so it pins neither the error nor the disposition here.
